Name: Wildroot Chronicles
Author: Owenynk112
Description:
[color=#d9ead3][b][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]You've planted parsnips a thousand times.
But this time is different — some grow faster, or draw a drift of butterflies...[/font][/size][/b][/color]
[center][color=#a64d79][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]Wildroot Chronicles transforms your farm into a living breeding garden！[/font][/size][/color][/center]

[center][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#6aa84f][size=5]At a glance[/size][/color][/font][/b][/center]
[color=#ffffff][font=Comic Sans MS][b][size=4]100[/size][/b][size=4] traits[/size][size=4] · [/size][b][size=4]12[/size][/b][size=4] rare species[/size][size=4] · [/size][b][size=4]12[/size][/b][size=4] new crops[/size][size=4] · [/size][b][size=4]5[/size][/b][size=4] characters (3 romanceable) [/size][size=4]· [b]50+ [/b][/size][size=4]story events · 2[/size][size=4] new locations[/size][size=4] · and a Breeding Almanac![/size][/font][/color]

[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#ea9999][size=4]English，简体中文[/size][/color][/b] [/font][/size]
[line]
[size=4][font=Arial Black]1.3.0 Update[/font][/size]
[color=#e69138][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Wings Over Fields[/i][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#e69138][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1787301684-1709608263.gif[/img][/i][/font][/size][/color]
[size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][i][color=#ffd966]Enjoy the pleasure of cultivating flowers and tea, and enjoy the magnificent scene of butterfly migration！[/color][/i][/font][/size]
[size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][i][color=#ffd966][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1787301655-1277526154.gif[/img][/color][/i][/font][/size]
[line]
[size=5][font=Georgia]Main content[/font][/size]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffe599][size=5][i]THE BREEDING SYSTEM [/i][/size][/color][/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]🧬 [i][color=#b6d7a8]EVERY HARVEST TELLS A STORY[/color][/i][/size][/font]
[font=Georgia]Your crops are no longer static. 64 inheritable traits, including:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]Practical mutations — faster growth, faster regrowth, bigger yields, higher quality... [/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia]Visual effects — a soft glow, drifting butterflies and fireflies, petal rain... [/font][/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1784386956-1192676141.gif[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1784386957-792050921.gif[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1786115857-885836651.gif[/img]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b][i][color=#93c47d][size=4]🌾 BREED, STABILIZE, AND NAME YOUR OWN VARIETIES[/size][/color][/i][/b][/font]
[font=Georgia]Use the Pruning Shears to take samples, then combine them at the [b]Breeding Station[/b]:
[color=#ffe599][b]Plant → mutate → sample → breed → stabilize → inherit[/b][/color][/font]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1787410017-359152747.png[/img]
[line]
[size=5][font=Georgia]😉[color=#dd7e6b]Meet Custom Characters！[/color][/font][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1787464882-1599615188.png[/img]
[line]
[i][size=4][color=#a64d79]🌸 [/color][color=#f4cccc]KEEP A BREEDING ALMANAC AND HUNT THE LEGENDARY BLOOMS[/color][/size][/i]
[size=4][color=#ffe599][font=Georgia]Everything you find gets written down. Traits, varieties, rare species, cultivation conditions, and a photo album[/font][/color] [/size]
[i][size=4][color=#f4cccc][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1787415039-418191284.png[/img][/color][/size][/i]
[i][color=#e06666][size=4]⚔️VISIT NEW LOCATIONS[/size][/color][/i]
[i][size=4][color=#cccccc]Monsters and treasures are waiting[/color][/size][/i]
[i][color=#e06666][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1787463821-19047440.png[/img][/size][/color][/i]
[line]

[i][b][size=5][font=Georgia]Want to know more? You can use the [color=#ff0000]offline wiki provided in the optional files[/color]![/font][/size][/b][/i]
[i][b][size=5][font=Georgia][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1787301656-2117264207.gif[/img][/font][/size][/b][/i]
[line]

[b][size=5][color=#ff7700][font=Comic Sans MS]！Update Roadmap！[/font][/color][/size][/b]

[font=Comic Sans MS][i][b][color=#fce5cd][size=4]Major Content Updates[/size][/color][/b][/i]
[b][size=4]1.[color=#1155cc]A deeper Nightwatchers’ Guild content [/color][/size](New mechanism, the 2nd floor map) & [color=#f6b26b][size=4]Character expansion[/size][/color] (including events, marriageable, new characters)[/b][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]2.[/b][color=#d5a6bd] [size=4]Exhibition Tent rework[/size][/color].(currently has a weak connection with breeding. Will add [color=#ffe599]collection content and improve the scoring system[/color])[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]3.[color=#ff0000][size=4]Optimizations on other QO[/size][/color][color=#cc0000][size=4]L[/size][/color](For example, the [color=#ffd966]optimization of breeding operations[/color], and providing [color=#ffd966]more comprehensive in-game guidance content.[/color])[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]4. And more...[/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][i][color=#fce5cd][size=4]Other Plans[/size][/color][/i]
[i][b]Lite version[/b][/i]
[i]Once the main version reaches a sufficiently stable state, a separate Lite version is planned for release.[/i]
[i]The Lite version will focus primarily on the mod’s characters, maps, dialogue, and story content. Breeding and other major gameplay systems will not be included, making it more suitable for players who are mainly interested in exploring the new areas and meeting the characters.[/i][/font]
[line]

[font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#e06666][size=4][i]🔧 INSTALLATION[/i][/size][/color][/b][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Requires [color=#9900ff][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/color].  [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install [color=#cc0000]SMAPI (4.0.0+)[/color] and [color=#cc0000]Spacecore.[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Unzip Cropgenics into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][b][i][color=#f6b26b]Generic Mod Config Menu recommended[/color][/i][/b] [/font][/*]
[/list][line]
[font=Comic Sans MS][i][color=#d8d8d8][size=4]⚙️ COMPATIBILITY[/size][/color][/i][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Most expansion mods — compatibility included[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Multiplayer — supported, with shared progress [/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Works with most vanilla and mod-added crops that follow the game's standard crop data structure[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Install in an existing save[/font]

[line]
[font=Comic Sans MS][i][b][size=4]🐛 BUGS & SUGGESTIONS[/size][/b][/i][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Cropgenics is still growing. If something breaks, include steps to reproduce and your SMAPI log (upload at smapi.io/log and paste the link in the Posts tab). [/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#e69138][size=4]Suggestions — new traits, rare flowers, balance feedback, event ideas — are just as welcome; I read every post.[/size][/color][/b][/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][i][b][size=4]❤️ SPECIAL THANKS[/size][/b][/i][/font]
[left][size=3][font=Arial Black]To the Stardew Valley modding community, the SMAPI team, the wiki contributors, and everyone who tried Cropgenics early, reported bugs, or simply enjoys growing strange little plants. 🌱😊[/font][/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=3][font=Arial Black]Thanks to these video creators for being willing to try and showcase the mod during its early versions![/font][/size][/left]

Manifest.Name: Wildroot Chronicles
Manifest.Description: Wildroot Chronicles is a crop-breeding overhaul for Stardew Valley 1.6. Discover natural traits, breed and stabilize new varieties, and cultivate rare flowers through ecological rituals. Adds Fernando, Oriko, Felix, Ariel, and Laurent; the Breeding Almanac and exhibition tent; and a Primal Grove research camp with gathering, fishing, barter, and story progression. Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded.
Manifest.Author: Wildroot Chronicles Team
